notes.title: hackmud seasons
notes.content:
[p]We are very excited to share some big changes we have made, moving us towards our grander vision of hackmud. Building off your feedback and our recent releases ([url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/469920/view/4487369735223116901?l=english"]the Marks system[/url] and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/469920/view/543361383085900241?l=english"]priv_store[/url]), this update continues to improve our new player experience and also adds a deep system that makes high-level play richer.[/p][p]Our primary goal continues to be a financially healthy game that pays for servers and ongoing development. Earlier this year, game sales, the in-game store, and [url="https://comcode.org/donate"]monthly supporters[/url] became enough to cover our ongoing server costs. This is a huge milestone for us. Our next target is being able to fund development, allowing us to continue creating new features and systems.[/p][p]We believe with a larger playerbase we will be able to earn enough to support ongoing development: if you love hackmud, tell a friend. If you wouldn’t, tell us why. Your feedback strongly shapes what we build next.[/p][p]Without further ado...[/p][p][/p][h2]Introducing hackmud Seasons[/h2][p]The game now follows two-month long season cycles, with co-op and competitive goals organized through in-game corporations.[/p][p]To support this structure, this release adds hidden marks and qubits, a new non-hidden mark, trade updates, a Corporation Shares & Dividends system, refinements to corps.top, and a season-ending event that closes the loop and sets up the next season.[/p][p][/p][h2]Hidden Marks & Qubits[/h2][p][b]Hidden Marks[/b] are achievements recorded in marks.protocol which are awarded when you take specific actions. We’ve added a lot of them (we’re not saying how many). Find them all![/p][p][b]Qubits (ⓠ)[/b] are a new resource added to the game. A potential currency. A quantum quantification of your knowledge. Earn them through discovering and understanding the edges of the systems in game.[/p][p]Qubits remain latent until a corporation realizes them through a trade. Once realized, they become Bits in the corp's bit purse. Mutuality is mandatory. Choose your partners carefully.[/p][p][/p][h2]Trade System Updates[/h2][p]You can now trade with corps and as a corp representative. When a trade sends Bits (⌽) to a corp, they land in a shared corp purse; admins can disburse from there. Before you use it, take a minute to audit who your corp admins are.[/p][p]Use `trade_corp` to act on behalf of your corp. There are stackable fee reductions for corp representatives as well as for elite-level supporters.[/p][p][b]Donations[/b][/p][p]Donations are trades which offer only bits from an individual into a corp. Donations do not have a fee. Qubits (ⓠ) are realized through donation. You can combine Qubits and Bits to reach the donation total; the corp only sees the final Bits amount, not how many qubits you used. Choose your partners carefully.[/p][p][/p][h2]Corporate Ranking System Altered[/h2][p]`corps.top` rankings are now sorted by qubits realized. The board shows more corporations, but there’s a floor to keep the signal clear: corps must realize a minimum amount of Qubits to appear on the list.[/p][p]Also added: the list of admins for each corp, and sorting by GC networth via sort: "gc".[/p][p][/p][h2]Mysterious New Mark[/h2][p]the plains of abeyance have been repurposed/repartitioned to facilitate new progress-based incentives, compatible with trust’s marks subsystem. the subversion has already manifested. bear witness with [b]marks.available[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Corporation Share and Dividends System[/h2][p]This system rewards all corporations on corps.top at the end of the season. It encourages cooperation in getting new players up to speed and extracting their latent wealth. `corps.share` is the entry point.[/p][p]Progress is shown with a percentage bar indicating what share of this season’s active players have hit their individual qubit-realization target.[/p][p]At season’s end, eligible corps on corps.top unlock escalating, stackable dividend rewards based on the percentage. Entry-level dividends grant useful upgrades for script-writing and infiltration. Mid-tier dividends deliver sets of high-end upgrades suited to different proficiency tiers. Top-tier dividends include a chance at powerful, very rare upgrades.
As corps work together - as well as against each other - everyone will receive the same share.[/p][p][/p][h2]Season End Event[/h2][p]Every season ends with a dedicated HYPETRAIN-SPEEDRUN-NOOBHARVEST™ event. During the event duration, signing in counts your account's realized qubits as double toward the season share, and the qubit threshold for the progress bar is halved. So one active player can cover their own requirement plus cover three others’ percentages.[/p][p]We're starting out with a BANG, as this [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/469920/view/534361794856094278"]season's end event[/url] is TOMORROW! This gives a lil time to play with the systems before next season's full season.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other New Features[/h2][p][b]LEVELGATE kernel patch[/b][/p][p]We’re continuing to tune the balance between [i]feeling dangerous[/i], [i]learning about danger[/i], and [i]being dangerous[/i]. New LEVELGATE policies let you set a minimum security level for scripts a user can run. Configure per-user with kernel.level_gate; temporarily bypass with kernel.level_bypass.[/p][list][*][p]The default lowest security level is MIDSEC.[/p][/*][*][p]Recently active users have been set to NULLSEC. Check your level_gate settings on your users.[/p][/*][*][p]Trust-script security levels have been adjusted to fit this model.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]marks.clone[/b][/p][p]Use marks.clone to copy earned Marks between users on the same account.[/p][p][b]corps.hire rescind[/b][/p][p]Use corps.hire {rescind:true} to rescind outstanding corp invites.[/p][p][/p][h2]Thank You to our Supporters[/h2][p]These features were made possible by the Mann family, the JRBF Foundation, and players like you[/p][p][/p][p][b]Benefactors[/b][/p][p][i]dunce elliptick jab marto[/i][/p][p align="justify"][b]Elite Supporters[/b] [i]flutterbyskies apogee aura beardzley bowkill cereal cheshyr coolguy3289 corial daniel dusky gear gleisen hawk jake jumpsplat120 kitsunet hechie lunarequest mr_greed myrmex ndeavor ratstick rinne seraphim sim soong southr6 sudonym tukib wintermute2[/i][/p][p][b]Supporters[/b]
[i]ducko official_pi_addict[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Consider joining these awesome folks and [url="https://comcode.org/donate"][u]becoming a supporter![/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p]Happy hacking, and see you in-game![/p][p]Sean & ComCODE[/p]

notes.title: hm_gamejam_v2
notes.content: [p]Alright everyone, [b]hm_gamejam_v2[/b] is officially done, and what a wild weekend it's been! You absolutely delivered on the [b]Kaizen[/b] theme of continuous improvement.[/p][p][/p][p]We saw [b]25 scripts submitted[/b], involving [b]49 unique players[/b], and [b]109 votes cast[/b] for [b]8430 total points[/b]. Huge shoutout to the [b]35 first-time jammers[/b] who jumped in![/p][p][/p][p]You created everything from nethack-like games to golf, gambling, cookie clickers and more, one incremental change at a time. We even got a tattoo out of it! Those last-minute uploads and script runs were CLUTCH.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Check Out All the Submissions![/b][/h3][p]If you haven't had a chance to explore them yet, you can find all the submitted games and scripts here:[/p][p][b]scripts.register { show: "list" }[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Take some time to jump into these: Play them, break them, and maybe give some feedback to your fellow jammers. These games are cool and a ton of fun. Also, the glam rewards generated by jam points are now available-- jump in-game to get your goodies! Find the reward hashes at [b]scripts.register[/b], available for EVERYONE![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26016191/a9c5d0e3a12bd87a8783b4f257d6070940897d6b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thanks to Our Community![/b][/h3][p]Please give a HUGE round of applause to everyone who submitted, played, voted, shared, or otherwise participated! Your energy made this jam RAD. Running these events is a blast because of how engaged, creative, and supportive this community is. You've all helped make this event and space awesome for anyone curious about creating, building, and bringing ideas to life![/p][p][/p][p]We also want to give a huge shoutout for your incredible show of support in helping us hype the launch of [b]Kaizen: A Factory Story[/b] for our friends over at Coincidence Games! But also, it's out now~[/p][p][b][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2275490/Kaizen_A_Factory_Story/"]Buy Kaizen: A Factory Story on Steam[/url][/u]! It’s RAD![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3][p]You poured your hearts, souls and memes into this jam, but the ACTION is over for the time being, so take a breather, get some rest if you need, and [u][url="https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/attention-economy-called-we-sent-voicemail-kyle-butcher-ivwce"]we'll be here whenever you've got the juice again[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you had fun building, because we had a great time hosting. We'll definitely be doing a [b]hm_gamejam_v3[/b], and we've already written down ways to make the next one even better![/p][p][/p][p]If you love hackmud, [u][url="https://givebutter.com/QncoAxxT2tdWf3UfJ2x95z25n1HNizxI"]consider becoming a supporter![/url][/u] We need your help! Just like the concept of kaizen, every dollar is one incremental step forward towards our goal of financial sustainability.[/p][p][/p][p]We also gave out a bunch of hackmud keys to our other friend organization, [b]Dames4Games.[/b] They will be streaming hackmud this upcoming weekend as part of their month-long fundraising effort for their non-profit, which creates spaces where everyone feels valued and celebrated in the gaming world, highlighting the amazing contributions of women and femme-identifying individuals in the game industry. They're also looking for people to stream to fundraise for them, too! [u][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc1UeqDBRV7onFLFCLWV77E1Xwlr9rKlxfIBjskHziQnymfBQ/viewform"]If you're a streamer and would like to sign up, that's rad![/url][/u] If you stream hackmud, we'll rally and all jump on your stream.[/p][p][/p][p]Otherwise, stay tuned for more community events, updates and news! We've got a bunch cookin' up! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26016191/50bca1319a8451d8e5da6c9c4aa2ed2c1445a4a9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Soft Reset, Hardline Engage
notes.content: [p]Hello hackmudders![/p][p][/p][p]We've been hard at work hacking stuff together and are thrilled to announce a major update! The centerpiece is the official launch of our Original Soundtrack Vol. 2, crafted by the amazing Ryan Ike. These new tracks, which have been in the works since 2018, join the iconic soundscape created for OST 1 by the legendary Lena Raine.[/p][p]This soundtrack is just one part of a major update that moves us closer to our grander[b] [/b]vision for the game, deepens our investment in our community, and kicks off a surprise crossover event.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Sound: Original Soundtrack Vol. 2[/b][/h3][p]After a lot of hard work and years, we are jazzed that we have finally finished the second volume of the [i]hackmud[/i] soundtrack. This update adds a whole bunch of new music to the game, with a heavy emphasis on hardline tracks. Alongside these new additions, we have also brought the original OST 1 hardline tracks back into the game, fully integrated with the new audio system.[/p][p]The Wait Is Over™–Hot off the digital presses, the 1-800-bangerz-only [b]Original Soundtrack Vol. 2[/b] is now available for purchase on [url="https://ryanike.bandcamp.com/album/hackmud-vol-2-original-game-soundtrack"]bandcamp[/url]! If you love how hard it goes as much as we do, you should definitely explore more of Ryan Ike's badass discog on his [u][url="https://www.ryanike.com/"]homepage[/url][/u]. The new soundtrack is also available on all major streaming platforms.[/p][p]At the same time, we're thrilled to announce that the legendary [b]Original Soundtrack Vol. 1[/b] by Lena Raine has been added to all major streaming platforms for the first time! You can also purchase it directly on [u][url="https://radicaldreamland.bandcamp.com/album/hackmud-ost-vol-1-lena-raine"]bandcamp[/url][/u], and be sure to check out more of her iconic work on [u][url="http://radicaldream.land"]radicaldream.land[/url][/u].[/p][p]We've integrated these new tracks directly into the game's environment, where you will experience them through gameplay, and tracks are tied to the difficulty of content.[/p][p]For those who want more control over their audio experience, this update also adds cool new audio functionality inside the game. Individual tracks can be purchased with bits. Using the new [b]`gui.tracks`[/b] command, you can customize your playlists. You can also assign your purchased hardline tracks to your loc using [b]`users.config`[/b], so other players will hear your track selections when they connect. It’s like jamming a mixtape into the boombox strapped to your loc's shoulder![/p][p]Get bits by purchasing them in the store or by trading GC and upgrades. [u][url="https://wiki.hackmud.com/guides/misc/supporter_benefits"]Supporters get the best value[/url][/u]: a bonus on all bits purchases and lower trade fees.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Get the Music:[/i][/b][i] Play the game, find the OSTs on Bandcamp and your favorite Streaming Services: [/i][url="https://song.link/hackmud-vol1"]OST1[/url] | [url="https://materia.to/Hackmud2"][u][i]OST2[/i][/u][/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Vision: A Retro-Futurist RPG[/b][/h3][p]The new soundtrack is a huge part of the game's identity. Alongside it, we want to share how we are aligning the game with its true identity: a [b]retro-futurist RPG[/b].[/p][p]We took our latest big step with [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/469920/view/4487369735223116901?l=english"]the marks system[/url][/u], and we continue today with the addition of priv_store. This acts as a personal safety deposit box for your GC, protecting up to 1B337MGC. The priv_store cannot be retired under any circumstances, so GC stored in your priv_store will be safe [u][url="https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/attention-economy-called-we-sent-voicemail-kyle-butcher-ivwce/?trackingId=mA8Pl7HlSErkBKoWSIJDpg%3D%3D"]if you step away; come back anytime[/url][/u] and you’ll have a nest-egg to get you started again. [/p][p]This change is part of a larger philosophy. We believe PvP and multiplayer are the 'danger spice' of hackmud's roleplaying-- but right now, that spice is too spicy, especially for players just starting out or returning. To that end, we have also begun making balance and quality of life changes at the lower tiers to allow people to get into the game with less friction. Some of these changes have already gone live, and we will continue developing the game toward this vision with your support.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Try it out:[/b] [/i][url="steam://rungameid/469920/"]Log in now[/url][i] to check out priv_store and experience the new balance changes for yourself.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Community: Cultivating our Shared Space[/b][/h3][p]It is Pride Month! [i]hackmud[/i] is, and always will be, a queer-friendly community. To celebrate, we have been reaching out to underserved and underrepresented communities interested in tech, as well as engineers and professionals recently impacted by the current economic climate. At the time of this announcement, we have given away more than 200 free [i]hackmud[/i] keys to awesome partners, local and global:[b] [u][url="https://www.lamberthouse.org/"]Lambert House[/url][/u], transprogrammers, [u][url="https://hope-adongo-school-limited.webflow.io/"]Hope Adongo School - Kenya[/url][/u], piratesoftware and more, [/b]and we are still going! [/p][p]We also want to formally recognize the players who make this community great. [url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KHi6j3qtCMDSDIu4ktl1Gz7ziUSTodBVVWR1WkfWEI4/edit"]We have created the helperbot_v2 role[/url] to say “THANKS” to those who consistently help others, and create a welcoming space for people of all backgrounds and skill levels. This quarter's awesome [b]helperbot_v2[/b]s are: gear, jumpsplat120, marto, sudonym, and zez! Hit 'em with a 🎉 emoji when you see them.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Get Involved:[/i][/b][i] If you know of a community or organization that we should connect with, please reach out in our discord, or on LinkedIn and let us know.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Event: A Planned Coincidence[/b][/h3][p]We're incredibly excited to announce our next event: an official [i]hackmud[/i] game jam to support [b]Coincidence[/b] ([u][url="https://coincidence.games/"]the artists formerly known as Zachtronics[/url][/u]) with the launch of their new game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2275490/Kaizen_A_Factory_Story/"]Kaizen: A Factory Story[/url]![/p][p]We’ve always been huge fans. The games they create strongly align with our own ComCODE mission, so we're hosting this jam right inside [i]hackmud[/i] to channel that shared energy and build excitement for their launch.[/p][p]Remember the goal of our jams: "hacking together experiences and other cool stuff." And while community voting can be sweet, the real win is seeing a flood of new creations for everyone to enjoy. notes.title: hm_gamejam_v1 has concluded!
notes.content:
[h1]hm_gamejam_v1 - That’s a Wrap!  [/h1]

[b]TLDR[/b]; Awesome! Check out all of the hm_gamejam_v1 submissions, and get your participation goodies at [b]scripts.register[/b] in-game.

Well, that was a wild week. Our first-ever hackmud Game Jam has come to a close, and honestly? Wild success. You all designed, scripted, tested, broke things, fixed them (or didn’t), and somehow shipped a working game in seven days. That’s awesome.  

[h2]Event Highlights[/h2]  

- [b]Theme[/b]: [i]Point of No Return[/i] (very dramatic, good job)  
- [b]Submissions[/b]: We had [b]22 scripts[/b] enter the arena.
- [b]Voting[/b]: Over [b]80 votes[/b] cast—some of them probably with regret, but hey, that’s democracy.  
- [b]Live Iteration[/b]: Unlike normal game jams, we let you [b]edit your script mid-event[/b] because constraints are for other people.  

[h2]What We Learned[/h2]  

This wasn’t just about making games—it was about [b]speedrunning the dev cycle[/b]. You brainstormed, built, got feedback, pivoted (or doubled down), and actually shipped something. Some of you even discovered why **scope creep is evil** in real time.  

Whether this was your first script or just another week in January, you [b]finished something[/b], and that’s huge.  

[h2]The Players & Voters[/h2]  

This jam wouldn’t have been what it was without the [b]players and voters[/b]. You explored the submissions, pushed buttons, broke things (probably on purpose), and your feedback made these scripts even better. Your votes shaped the event, and your engagement kept the chaos rolling.  
Some of you even had to make the tough call of [b]what to upvote and what to downvote[/b]—which, let’s be honest, was the real game all along. Whether you were a tester, critic, or just here to see what kind of madness unfolded, you were just as much a part of this jam as the jammers themselves.  

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]  

Did you have fun? Did you suffer? Did you learn something? Hopefully, yes to all three. This jam wasn’t about "winning" (there were no winners, only survivors). It was about [b]creating cool stuff and seeing what everyone else came up with[/b]—and you [b]all delivered[/b].  

And guess what? [b]We’re doing this again[/b]. So keep those scripts warmed up, because there will be more. Probably when you least expect it.

Thanks for making [b]hm_gamejam_v1[/b] legendary. Now go touch some grass.  

— ComCODE

notes.title: A New Era of hackmud
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the launch of the Marks System, a new way to play, learn, and progress in [i]hackmud[/i]. Designed for players of all backgrounds and skill levels - including those who’ve never been introduced to computer science concepts - this system begins by teaching the essentials of [i]hackmud[/i] and building a strong foundation so that anyone can dive into this incredible game.

[h2]What’s a Mark?[/h2]

Marks are interactive challenges that begin by teaching players the basics of [i]hackmud[/i] in a straightforward and slightly more guided way. They introduce key concepts and skills to help you navigate the game and solve problems - [b]no prior knowledge needed[/b].

Here’s a categorization preview for the connoisseur and the curious:

- [b]Required Marks:[/b] Critical knowledge and skills to get up and running in [i]hackmud[/i].
- [b]Suggested Marks:[/b] Commonly utilized scripts, concepts, and strategies that enhance your abilities.
- [b]Optional Marks:[/b] Deeper challenges for those seeking arcane knowledge and opportunities.
- [b]Hidden Marks:[/b] The secrets of [i]hackmud[/i], rewarding those who venture beyond the illuminated paths.

[h2]Why It Matters[/h2]

The Marks System is a game-changer for [b]new players[/b]. It’s designed to help you feel at home in the game without overwhelming you. The goal is to teach you how to think and act in [i]hackmud[/i], not just complete rote tasks. As you explore and discover, you’ll build confidence and be ready to dive deeper into the game.

For [b]existing players[/b], the Marks System will grow and expand over time to cover the deepest depths and highest challenges of [i]hackmud[/i]. Right now, we’re focusing on bringing new players into the fold and helping them learn at their own pace. You will be able to see changes and developments in real-time; just consult your available marks.

[h2]What Does This Mean for hackmud?[/h2]

We are officially [b]replacing the vLAN[/b] with our brand-new and ever-growing Marks System. This way, all players - new and old - can expand their horizons and gain new skills. This marks the [b]first major step[/b] toward aligning the game with our mission of empowering and inspiring people to learn more about systems literacy.

The vLAN is also not gone forever. The story and lore of [i]hackmud[/i] is an important part of the experience. Keep an eye out for updates!

This is just the beginning, and we will continue to develop, improve, and expand this new experience with your help and feedback.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

The system is live, and we can’t wait for you to get started. Here’s how you can jump in:

[h3]New Players[/h3]
- Create your first user and take your first steps into [i]hackmud[/i].

The time and energy that our community invests in Hackmud events means a huge amount to us, and we want to ensure that your investment is rewarded with an event that is as fair, fun, and robust as we can make it.

In order to do this, we're pushing back the start date of Monuments + Beacons by a week, to February 21st, 2020, at 1800 UTC. We're very sorry for the delay and for any disappointment caused, but we believe that this'll result in a better season in the long run.

We hope that you'll join us tomorrow, February 13th, for MUDCON 2020 @ 2000UTC - a video call where Hackmud players and developers gather to talk about the state of the MUD, ask questions, and share stories.

Even if you can't make it to MUDCON, you'll find some little friends waiting for you in-game on February 21st.

notes.title: 2.2.0 Patch Notes
Inner Territories Launch Imminent
notes.content:
Hello!

This week we're releasing Inner Territories, the first seasonal update for Hackmud. As we detailed back in September, we've got a bunch of new features planned, including a new currency, a new secure trading system, and customizable user profiles.

We'll be posting patch notes and beginning the rollout of the update on November 8th, 2019 at 1800 UTC.

There are a few topics that we'd like to raise before launch day.

The first is that Hackmud is developed by a (very!) small team, and while we're testing the new features behind the scenes we fully expect to be implementing tweaks and fixes - and in some cases whole features - in the days following the initial update.

Hackmud players make the game what it is, and we really appreciate your feedback, support and patience while we figure out any issues that may arise. We're really excited for you to start playing with Inner Territories on November 8th. However, we also know that there'll be things that we want to change - so we're committing time and resources to make sure that we can provide regular patches in the weeks that follow.

The second topic concerns the new Bits currency and the in-game store that we're launching as part of this update. The store is intended to help support the ongoing development of Hackmud, and we've chosen this method because it allows players to participate as much or as little as they wish.

In addition to the current set of in-game purchases, you'll be able to buy titles and avatars to add to your user profiles. This is primarily an excuse to add ASCII Hats(TM) to Hackmud. However, we also intend it to act as a way for players to leave a tip if they enjoy a particular event or simply the game as a whole. We believe this is a fair, fun and voluntary way to allow players to support the game - and to become official party bus conductors, should they wish.

That's all for now! See you on Friday. Oh - before we go -

It says here that you're invited to something called the 'Fourth Revolutionary Convention', taking place from Friday at the 'Ministry of Dust'. Make of that whatyouwill.

notes.title: Inner Territories
notes.content:
Hey Mudders!

Last Sunday marked three years since hackmud released on Steam and about five years since I started working on this project.

Hackmud was a fever dream born out of necessity. While it may have started with just me and my bad ideas, it has grown into a whole lot more. Through the years many people have helped hackmud directly or indirectly, but none more than the community itself. Many would say that “hackmud is the community,” and I would absolutely agree that hackmud would not exist without it. If you are reading this, thank you. You all rock.

This game has been an experiment from day one. And in the spirit of that experimentation I’m proud to announce a new strategy for ongoing updates: seasons. This concept is not new to online games, and while being explicit about our future plans might be somewhat contrary to the spirit of hackmud, we believe the benefits of a reliable update schedule heavily outweigh any downsides. 

The current plan is to have four seasons a year, beginning in early February, early May, late July, and early November. Each season will have:
[list]
[*]An announcement with the start date for the season and an overview of the content that will be in it.
[*]An event and patch notes will be released at the start of the season.
[*]Quality of life improvements, new features, and other content across the spectrum tied together with a coherent theme.
[/list]
This is the current plan. We will absolutely be closely watching, listening and improving everything we do as we learn more about what fits this community best.

notes.title: Development Update 170511
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26016191/e5c583c41fd0c94dcde0080973583a5fb291ee3d.gif[/img]

Dearest Friends & Acquaintances of h a c k m u d

I'm super proud to announce the release of Bot Brains & Slot Upgrades!

[i]bot_brain[/i] upgrades allow you to automate your users when you are not sending them commands. Create and train an army of minions to help you mine resources, defend against hacks, infiltrate and disrupt others' botnets, have them manage weapons caches, banks, and so, so much more. 

Additional user and retirement slots are now available as well, so you can increase the subterfuge and deceit or build up your arsenal, or just grab up all those totally rad usernames you wanted.

Also, for those of you who have been on break from the game, here's a [i]quick as I can[/i] recap of features that have been added since the beginning of this year.

[list]
[*]A handful of events, including two player-run events which are still available - heart.beat and xoxo_amy.cortex
[*]Many locks have been added (sn_w_usac, l0g_wr1t3r, l0cks & k3ys, many more)
[*][url=https://twitter.com/CThursten]Chris Thursten[/url] has agreed to write words and puzzles in exchange for currency. I'm super pumped to have him on board.
[*]PvP continues to be fixed and broken. Balance updates are frequent!
[*]A chat API is available, allowing players to create custom chat clients
[*]A community-created open-source [url=https://www.hackmud.com/chat]web chat client[/url] has been created to let you chat in-game from outside of the game
[*]Tier 3 content
[*]Many months of stability, performance, and security improvements
[*]Trust script updates (market.*, sys.*, gui.*)
[*]Client side macros with arguments
[*]Advanced scripting improvements and features (#G, #db.i multi insert, etc.)
[/list]

To see the whole patch note history, take a look here:
https://hackmud.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/206365928-Patch-Notes

To see answered & fixed community requests take a look here:
https://hackmud.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/115000176727--archived-Bugs-Features-Ideas?sort_by=votes

Hope to see you all in game!

Best,
Sean

notes.title: Development Update 161109
notes.content:
It has been too long.

Dear hackmudders--

Some news:
Last weekend on the 5th of November I ran hackmud's first event. It was the first time I really felt like this game was a sustainable enterprise. A solid handful of content was delivered, players played really hard and many had an EXCELLENT time. While the content this time was only of the most difficult tier of play, I'd very much like future events to be able to be enjoyed by all tiers of play.

The past month and a half has been a lot of catching up to players: fixing server performance, fixing bugs, exploits, complex design to guide better interactions; and while I've made excellent progress in catching up (server performance is consistent and snappy, etc), I'm still behind. This will definitely get better over time (it already has), but it still eats at feature work in a big way. To date, the game has earned enough to keep the game running into next year. I hope to turn that into much longer. :)

From a business perspective, the two largest goals are to create stable earnings from the player base, and reduce server costs. I will be using techniques that provide value to players to accomplish these goals (valuable in-game purchasable content that doesn't impact game balance, server performance improvements & optimization)

At the same time, I'll be continuing to add meaningful content and features to the game. (Your help prioritizing this has been invaluable; I regularly look at these forums: https://hackmud.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/201120367-Bugs-Features-Ideas?sort_by=votes)

Additional information:
- Patch notes are posted here: https://hackmud.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/204072668-Patch-Notes -- I'll attempt to cross-post them here as well.
- I've taken the time to construct more clear rules and I'm continuing to improve on them: https://hackmud.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/204058488-rules
- The price of the game is currently a discount in all currencies-- some more than others. This will be increasing as the community matures, bugs are fixed, and new content is added.

I appreciate all of your support, patience, and feedback. You all rock.

Best,
Sean

notes.title: Development Update 160929
notes.content:
First off: THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH!

It is officially one week since launch. I am the only dev on this project and I am so amazingly overworked at the moment. <3
The servers have been stable for several days, and players are hacking in so many ways!
They are spoofing, scripting, deceiving, lying, and fighting their way to victory!
MUDWAR-1 has already come and gone, with new intrigue developing every day--

However, I can't keep up with players right now! Which means I can't make new features and fix balance issues!

Here are ways YOU can help with my workload:

-> Help new players wherever you can! In game, steam forums, game forums, discord, wherever there are people!

-> !!DO NOT BREAK THE SANDBOX!! <--

- there are so many ways to hack this game INSIDE the game, please help me by not doing it 'outside the game'
- do not create custom clients
- do not write scripts that crash other player's clients
- do not write scripts that invalidate the "trustedness" of scripts.trust scripts
- contact support@hackmud.com if you see any of these issues

MANY of these things will be available and approved in the future. I just can't handle the workload right now. 

-> !!DO NOT CREATE MORE WORK FOR ME!! <-

Violators will be removed temporarily or permanently.

Please contact support@hackmud.com if you have any questions about this.

Happy Hacking!
Sean
